name: Be Still
overview: The Scriptures call believers to a posture of trust and quiet confidence in God's sovereign care. As Exodus 14:14 assures, the LORD Himself will fight on our behalf, enabling us to hold our peace. Psalms 37:7 encourages resting and waiting patiently on the Lord without anxiety over the apparent success of the wicked, while Psalms 46:10 commands us to be still and recognize God's supreme authority. This stillness is not passive resignation but a deliberate act of faith grounded in the knowledge that God is our refuge and strength (Psalm 46:1) and our faithful shepherd who provides all we need (Psalm 23:1). Even in our struggles, as Job 6:24 models, we seek God's teaching and remain silent before Him, acknowledging His wisdom and our dependence.
